name: Endless Slumber
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, mesmerist 5, occultist 6, psychic 6, shaman 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (a pinch of black sand)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell and cause the target to fall into a permanent magically-induced slumber. This operates as the sleep spell for the purposes of how the target may be awakened. Otherwise, the target may make a new save every 24 hours to awaken early. The subject does not need to eat or drink during this time, though they still age and need to breathe.
